agyos_skill.intent: Master automated billing systems including recurring billing, invoice generation, dunning management, proration, and tax calculation.
agyos_skill.instructions: Master automated billing systems including recurring billing, invoice generation, dunning management, proration, and tax calculation. - Implementing SaaS subscription billing - Automating invoice generation and delivery - Managing failed payment recovery (dunning) - Calculating prorated charges for plan changes - Handling sales tax, VAT, and GST - Processing usage-based billing - Managing billing cycles and renewals - You only need a one-off invoice or manual billing - The task is unrelated to billing or subscriptions - You cannot change pricing, plans, or billing flows - Define plans, pricing, billing intervals, and proration rules. - Map subscription lifecycle states and renewal/cancellation behavior. - Implement invoicing, payments, retries, and dunning workflows. - Model taxes and compliance requirements per region. - Validate with sandbox payments and reconcile ledger outputs. - If detailed templates are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. - Do not charge real customers in testing environments. - Verify tax handling and compliance obligations before production rollout. - `resources/implementation-playbook.md` for detailed patterns, checklists, and examples. - Use this skill only when the task clearly matches the scope described above. - Do not treat the output as a substitute for environment-specific validation, testing, or expert review. - Stop and ask for clarification if required inputs, permissions, safety boundaries, or success criteria are missing.
